digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown for snapshot cache
propositions: macOS pytest basetemp cleanup fails with PermissionError when read-only snapshot directories (.rebar/run_snapshots) are left behind by snapshot-producing tests
Production snapshot publication intentionally applies 0444/0555 permissions via snapshot._chmod_readonly, preventing standard rm -rf from removing the tree
Cleanup was owned only by module-local fixture in test_snapshot.py, leaving read-only .rebar/run_snapshots roots when snapshot producers run in other test modules
Shared pytest teardown fixture must be moved to conftest.py to enforce cleanup invariant across all test modules that produce snapshots
The fix reuses snapshot._rmtree_writable to make read-only snapshot cache roots removable during shared teardown without changing production behavior
